subs.note: Mathurin Forestier. The movements of the mass, each on its own.

items.title: Kyrie (Forestier, Missa Baisez moy)
items.desc: Mathurin Forestier, Missa Baisez moy, Kyrie, 1513–1514. 5 voices (Discantus, Contratenor, Tenor resolutio/Tenor 1, Tenor/Tenor 2, Barricanor/Barriton), each on its own staff. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
